mapper.select:
SELECT sar.student_id as studentId, u.user_name as studentName, ep.title as paperTitle, c.class_name as className, MAX(sar.submit_time) as submitTime, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN (1,2,3,4) THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN (1,2,3,4) AND sar.review_status = 1 THEN sar.score ELSE 0 END) ELSE NULL END as autoScore, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sar.review_status = 0 THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'completed' END as reviewStatus, sar.paper_id as paperId FROM student_answer_record sar LEFT JOIN user u ON sar.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN exam_paper ep ON sar.paper_id = ep.id LEFT JOIN class c ON ep.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN question q ON sar.question_id = q.id
sar.paper_id = #{paperId}
sar.status = 1
GROUP BY sar.student_id, sar.paper_id, u.user_name, ep.title, c.class_name ORDER BY sar.student_id

SELECT sar.*, u.user_name as studentName, u.user_name as realName, q.question_type as questionType, q.stem, q.options, q.answer as correctAnswer, q.score as questionScore, q.analysis FROM student_answer_record sar LEFT JOIN user u ON sar.student_id = u.id LEFT JOIN question q ON sar.question_id = q.id WHERE sar.paper_id = #{paperId} AND sar.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sar.id
